scope: Temporary helper registration/update/uninstall tests with fake Flatpak command ledger; actual desktop-file-validate and gio launch through the generated wrapper. No real Flatpak installation, native gameplay, network download or user storage changes claimed by this report. Native sandbox acceptance is separate.
guards: Foreign helpers inside existing Flatpak repository are preserved
Dangling command and desktop symlinks cannot be overwritten or followed
Selected installation and ownership marker cannot redirect to another prefix
Owned missing wrapper repairs its own dangling command link
Changed helper blocks update and survives uninstall
Uninstall preserves saved data, repository and changed/foreign shortcuts
Failed Flatpak command preserves existing registration
Folder picker cancellation runs no Flatpak command
Partial registration rolls back earlier owned writes
Exact legacy checksums permit upgrade to hashed ownership
Native verified bundle import checks exact application ID and commit
Existing application updates without uninstall through its exclusive auto-created local origin
Shared Flathub/other-app origins and externally changed URLs are preserved
File repository URI encodes percent, spaces and special path characters
Deployment commit is verified so a native no-op cannot claim an update
